findings.title: Keep raw readiness and credentials outside the cold-client argument

The removed artifact lookup is gone and no present positive lookup of targets is alleged, but raw readiness still crosses the explicitly forbidden oracle input seam.

findings.title: Assert captured context for installed minimum failures
findings.problem: The minimum-order loop calls d3Context only in the success else branch. Its seven error cases per route (410/409/503, including HEAD) verify status/code/length/retry but can pass with missing or incorrect BDP-Scope-Epoch, BDP-Authorization-View or BDP-Scope-Position headers. f.send does not assert those fields.
findings.requirement: /Users/dbox/repos/wt/vickie/bdp-integration-logs/tx-discovery-next-plan-4/plan.md:75 requires actual epoch/view/contextpos1 for ordering cases
findings.impact: A private installed projection that drops or misbinds error context can satisfy this witness even though captured same-entry failure context is the law under test. Source tests do not substitute for installed wire validation.
findings.smallestCorrection: Assert d3Context(response, nav.epoch, nav.view, "pos-1") for every case, before or in both branches, including foreign input tuples and timeout/bodyless HEAD failures. Keep exact current status/problem/retry/length assertions and the same15 requests per callback.

findings.title: Include CRLFCRLF in both local raw header ceilings
